name: DingTalk Notifications
description: Send one-on-one messages to colleagues as a DingTalk notification bot registered by your admin, and check their replies and read receipts.
authorization.title: Choose a Notification Bot
authorization.description: When authorizing, choose one of the DingTalk bots your admin registered under “IM Bots” with the “Notification” purpose and made visible to you; no credentials are needed. Each connection maps to one bot, and you can add several. The admin must grant the bot's app the robot messaging permission (qyapi_robot_sendmsg) and, for finding people, the directory search, member read, member-by-mobile and department read permissions, and enable Stream push with the “Robot message read” event in event subscriptions.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.find.title: Find Colleagues
capabilities.find.description: Find colleagues by name or mobile number, with their DingTalk user ID, title, employee number and departments to tell namesakes apart.
capabilities.departments.title: Select by Department
capabilities.departments.description: Search departments by name, browse sub-departments and list department members to notify a whole department.
capabilities.send.title: Send Notifications
capabilities.send.description: Send a Markdown one-on-one message to one or more colleagues as the bot, in batches of 20.
capabilities.recall.title: Recall Messages
capabilities.recall.description: Recall one-on-one messages sent by the bot by send batch; all recipients in a batch are recalled together.
capabilities.events.title: Check Replies and Reads
capabilities.events.description: Query replies and read receipts by message, employee or time to find who has not read or replied.
limits.title: Scope
limits.description: Messages can only reach employees within the bot app's visible range. A reply is linked to a notification only when the employee quotes it. Each send and recall requires confirmation and is never retried automatically. Recall works per send batch, so up to 20 recipients in a batch are recalled together. After a send timeout, check read receipts or ask the recipients before sending again.
examples.title: Examples
examples.notice.title: Send an Alert
examples.notice.description: Send today's finished-product exceptions to Zhang San and Li Si in Quality and ask them to quote-reply with their handling plan.
examples.follow.title: Check Progress
examples.follow.description: Who hasn't read that notification yet, and who has replied?
